svg.title: CASTAWAY: Island Setup Utility
svg.desc: An 80 by 25 navy firmware setup screen titled CASTAWAY Island Setup Utility. A red bar walks a two-column menu of island settings and picks Save and Exit to Island; the main panel is then taken over by the island itself: CAST and AWAY in big orange-to-pink block letters either side of a palm that used to be the menu divider, a woman with headphones nodding on the sand, and a ship crossing the horizon exactly while she drinks from a coconut.
